description: This file defines a mock class 'WebAudioPlayerServerInternalMock' implementing the 'IWebAudioPlayer' interface for testing purposes within the 'firebolt::rialto::server' namespace. It includes mock methods for audio playback control, buffer management, device info retrieval, volume control, and client access.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerServerInternalMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IWebAudioPlayer interface for unit testing.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Mocks the play method to start audio playback.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Mocks the pause method to pause audio playback.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Mocks the method to set end-of-stream state.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of available buffer frames and shared memory info.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of current buffer delay in frames.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Mocks writing data to the buffer.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of device info including preferred and maximum frames, and support for deferred play.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the current volume level.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of the client interface.
